evidence.note: Official sources show ANSI/AAMA-292 withdrawn in 2002, ASTM D6673-10 withdrawn without replacement in 2019, and current CLO documentation naming modes without publishing exact layer semantics or an independent round trip. No receiver/profile or V03 gate changed.

text: S511 found primary-source evidence that known apparel DXF standards are legacy/withdrawn while current CLO help documents menu settings but not an exact layer map or conformance. Preserve all V03 gates; require exact receiver/build evidence and measured round trip before selecting a profile or claiming compatibility.
